Chomyfin_EditorDescription: Configure Chomikuj.pl access, .strm file synchronization, and advanced settings.
Chomyfin_Password_Description: Password for your Chomikuj.pl account (hidden in the interface).
Chomyfin_FolderPassword_Description: Password to access private protected folders such as 'Prywatne'
Chomyfin_StrmDestinationFolder_Descripti: Local directory on the server where the .strm library will be generated.
Chomyfin_SyncMode_Description: Choose whether to synchronize the entire Chomikuj account or only the specified folders.
Chomyfin_AllowedVideoExtensions_Descript: Comma-separated list of extensions (without dot). Only files with these extensions will generate a .strm file.
Chomyfin_OverwritePolicy_Description: Skip if the .strm file already exists (recommended) or update if the Chomikuj file URL has changed.
Chomyfin_DeleteOrphans_Description: ⚠️ WARNING: If enabled, local .strm files that no longer exist in your Chomikuj account will be deleted.
Chomyfin_OrphansDryRun_Description: While enabled, only logs which orphan .strm files would be deleted without removing them from disk.
Chomyfin_AutoSyncEnabled_Description: Enables recurring automatic execution of the sync task. If disabled, you can always run sync manually from Emby Scheduled Tasks.
Chomyfin_RefreshLibraryAfterSync_Descrip: Notifies Emby about added or deleted files when synchronization finishes.
Chomyfin_EnableSoapDiagnostics_Descripti: Logs raw XML from the SOAP API; for debugging purposes only
Chomyfin_LastSyncStatus_Description: Information about the last executed synchronization.
Chomyfin_ResolveSiblingVersions_Descript: When opening a movie or episode detail, resolves and caches alternative qualities in the background for instant playback.
Chomyfin_MaxSiblingsPerOpen_Description: Maximum number of alternative .strm files queued for background resolution on open (1-20).
Chomyfin_UseFastResolvePath_Description: Fast resolution path: uses a single request when the URL already contains the file id; falls back to the classic method if it fails.
Chomyfin_Status_NoSyncYet: No synchronization has been run yet.
